ko.title: 클라우드 인 어 보틀: 모두가 쉽게 셀프 호스팅을 할 수 있도록

key_takeaways: 복잡한 서버 설정 없이 간단한 명령어로 개인 클라우드 구축

en.title: Cloud in a Bottle: making self-hosting accessible to everyone
en.hook: An open-source solution to spin up self-hosted cloud storage in 1 minute via lightweight Docker containers with zero DevOps overhead.
key_takeaways: Deploy personal cloud services with a single command, no complex server setup
Lightweight Docker-based design minimizes hardware requirements
Enhance privacy and data control by avoiding centralized services

zh.title: 云瓶：让每个人都能轻松实现自托管
zh.hook: 通过轻量级 Docker 容器一键在1分钟内构建自托管个人云存储的开源方案，零运维门槛。
key_takeaways: 用一条命令即可部署个人云服务，无需复杂服务器配置
基于 Docker 的轻量级设计，硬件需求低
增强隐私和数据控制，避免集中式服务
